SpaceX announced plans to make Starlink Mobile a "major mobile carrier" in the US, thanks to two major new developments. Here are the details.

SpaceX announced two milestones, moving towards developing Starlink Mobile into a full-fledged mobile carrier

Starlink Mobile may soon become one of the full mobile carrier options for your iPhone.

SpaceX announced two major developments this week to achieve this goal.

  • A brand new "nationwide low-band spectrum license portfolio"
  • FCC approves Starlink Mobile's second-generation satellite constellation application

Most liked comment posted by Blake

Of course, it depends on whether the pricing is competitive and whether it actually provides practical value to me.

The former is an important milestone for Starlink Mobile to become a true alternative to other mobile carriers. SpaceX stated in the announcement:

Although final FCC approval has not yet been granted, SpaceX expects to receive it and to further deploy "a combination of our satellite-to-mobile communications constellation in space and a flexible architecture of advanced ground deployments".

However, the FCC has approved the deployment of 15,000 satellites designed for the global 2 GHz band. This batch of V2 Starlink Mobile satellites provides "over 100 times" the bandwidth, with speeds significantly higher than the current generation, expected to accelerate global connection speeds.

Are you interested in using Starlink Mobile as your iPhone's carrier? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
